id./param/scenario/cs/b_090_cs_010.pack|cs_: "...It's so quiet. And was that tacky statue here when I came before?
"Octagonia is now a happy paradise. Fighting here would be uncouth.
"The barbaric arena is passé! Now the Monster Casino built by Booga, a Spectral Sentinel, is the new attraction!
"If you're interested, do play at the casino upstairs. I can't say what will happen to you. Hee hee...
"It smells fishy, but Jade may be there. Let's try the casino upstairs."
